title: Between Century and Poet: Graph-Based Lexical Semantic Change in Persian Poetry
reasoning: The paper focuses on the lexical semantic change of mystical and Sufi vocabulary (e.g., 'fanaa', 'soofi', 'haqiqat', 'tariqat') within Persian poetry. It systematically evaluates how these spiritual and religious terms are rewired in semantic graphs over centuries, exploring their roles within doctrinal and mystical discourses.
